newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks down 2.30 pct on rupiah, H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks down 2.30 pct on rupiah, H1 results.

text.p: The Jakarta composite index was down 2.30 percent in late trading on Wednesday as investors sold stocks across the board due to worries over the central bank's tight rupiah policy and poor first-half results of some big-capitalised companies, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 16.42 points, or 2.30 percent, to 697.45 points at around 0755 GMT. Decliners led advancers by 143 to 11 with 25 issues unchanged.
Trading volume, however, was modest with an estimated total market turn-over of 311 billion rupiah.

"Players sold stocks across the board, with property stocks suffering the heaviest blow, because of the central bank's tight rupiah policy which prompted banks to raise interest rates," one broker said.
Brokers said disappointment over the first half results of some big-capitalised firms such as Semen Gresik and Tambang Timah further to weaken sentiment.
